<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-left">
    <p class="kicker mono">A LIVING WORLD BY PLAYBEAT</p>
    <h1>People<br>playing with<br>the <span class="beat">beat.</span></h1>
    <p>A place to meet the night on your own terms. Find your people, feel the bass, pick your ride and let the city move around you.</p>
    <div class="btnrow">
      <button class="cta">Enter the world</button>
      <button class="ghost">Explore the worlds ↓</button>
    </div>
    <div class="avatars">
      <div class="dot" style="background:var(--pink)"></div>
      <div class="dot" style="background:var(--blue)"></div>
      <div class="dot" style="background:var(--teal)"></div>
      <small>Come as you are. Always in motion.</small>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="frame">
    <div class="frame-inner" style="background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,')">
      <div class="scrim"></div>
      <div class="frame-badge">♪ Feel the bass — tap to turn on sound</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
